team.revertTitleAvailable: Revert latest carry-over ({{count}} reversible batches remaining)

team.editHint: Set off-platform work percentage and available cap (20% per workday); when lowering the cap or marking leave, select the exact leave workdays. The employee is notified upon saving.
team.forecastEditHint: Manually override future forecast baseline (0–200%) for unconfirmed weeks only; once formally confirmed, the confirmed schedule takes precedence.
team.crossWeekError: Multi-week edits only support updating "Off-platform work %"; to adjust available cap or time off dates, set start and end week to the same week.

team.crossWeekNote: Multi-week editing only updates "Off-platform work %", preserving each week's existing leave and cap. Edit a single week to change leave dates.

settings.impactDesc: Disabling hides the "Plan" section and related assistant tools. Existing planning records and employee profiles remain intact.
settings.helpContent: Applies to collaboration demands in planning. Selecting "All employees" allows both department managers and regular employees to initiate demands.
settings.elasticHint: Reserved elastic buffer: {{percent}}% (for ad-hoc or urgent external demands)
settings.capError: Please enter an integer percentage between 50 and 100.

rates.pulseHint: Drops to zero once done; suited for support, warehousing, short waves
rates.balancedHint: Decays to ~25% in 2 weeks; suited for regular cyclical work
rates.projectHint: High continuity; suited for R&D, design, consulting

forecastPolicy.orgDefaultHint: No custom org default policy configured: decays weekly at system default rate {{rate}} (next week = previous week × {{rate}}) with active events applied; regular quota {{cap}}% / elastic buffer {{elastic}}% only governs allocation limits and does not affect forecast baselines.
forecastPolicy.retentionLine: Weekly retention rate {{rate}} (next week forecast = previous week × {{rate}})
forecastPolicy.noManagedDeptHint: No managed departments. You can only view org default and parent policies.
forecastPolicy.jobFamilyPlaceholder: Leave blank for all job families, or enter/select one
forecastPolicy.recommendedFallbackHint: 0 Pulse (resets immediately) · 0.5 Balanced (~25% after 2 wks) · 0.8 Project (high continuity)
forecastPolicy.retentionRateHint: Next week forecast = previous week × retention rate (0 resets when done; higher values carry work forward longer).
forecastPolicy.policyNotePlaceholder: e.g., Temporarily raise baseline for peak season
forecastPolicy.eventsDesc: Apply temporary modifiers for specific weeks and departments/job families (e.g., supply pauses, promotions, peak spikes) without affecting confirmed schedules or manual overrides.
forecastPolicy.noEvents: No current or upcoming business fluctuation events.
forecastPolicy.eventTitlePlaceholder: e.g., No supplier deliveries next week
forecastPolicy.eventJobFamilyPlaceholder: Leave blank for all job families in the department
forecastPolicy.eventReasonPlaceholder: Explain the business reason and scope
